new_hypothesis.name: rpc_verified_wallet_only_copy_trade
new_hypothesis.mechanism: copy_trade has been dormant for 30+ days because its current 23-wallet list went stale - public leaderboards (gmgn/photon/birdeye) include wallets that have stopped trading or whose claimed P&L is fabricated/inflated. The actual edge is not 'use smart money wallets' (the bot tried that, lost 0.83 SOL lifetime) but 'use ONLY direct-RPC-verified-active wallets, with mandatory reverification every 7 days.' Direct-RPC verification proves: (a) the wallet is actually trading right now (last_activity <72h), (b) it has completed enough round-trips in recent history to compute a real WR, (c) realized P&L from on-chain pre/post token balances confirms or refutes the leaderboard claim.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Cloudflare blocks gmgn/photon/birdeye/dexscreener/solscan frontends, so most retail copy-trade tools cannot verify their own watchlists - they ingest leaderboards as-is and copy stale wallets. Bots that can directly query Solana RPC (we use paid Alchemy) have a structural moat: we filter out the dead wallets the rest of the copy-trade market is still chasing. This edge persists as long as the leaderboard-to-RPC gap exists.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: PROTOCOL: every 7 days, re-run getSignaturesForAddress (limit=100) + getTransaction (parsed) for every wallet in sol_target_wallets.json. Compute per-wallet: round_trips_N (FIFO buy/sell pairs on Raydium/PumpSwap/Meteora/Jupiter/Pump.fun), realized_WR, median_pnl_sol_per_RT, last_activity_h. KEEP only wallets with last_activity_h < 72 AND round_trips_N >= 5 AND realized_WR > 60% AND median_pnl_sol_per_RT > +0.10. DROP everything else. SEED: add 4Be9CvxqHW6BYiRAxW9Q3xu1ycTMWaL5z8NX4HR3ha7t immediately (100% WR / 8 RTs / +3.49 SOL median / active 2h ago). Initial copy_trade size = 0.05x (test) until N=10 new trades through the filtered list.
new_hypothesis.data_required: Already-configured Alchemy Solana RPC (ALCHEMY_SOLANA_RPC in .env). No new data source. Estimated RPC cost: ~25 wallets x 100 sigs + 100 txns = ~5000 RPC calls per weekly verification, well within Alchemy free tier. Ops impact: a single one-shot weekly cron task.
new_hypothesis.estimated_fires_per_day: 1-5 initially with only 4Be9Cv... in the seed list, expanding as more wallets get verified weekly. Current wallet 4Be9Cv... is making ~5-10 buys/day with 1-30 SOL position sizes - we mirror only the >5 SOL concentration buys, so ~1-3 fires/day.

proposals_for_survival_brain.target: copy_trade_wallet_curation (NEW reverification protocol; also adds 4Be9Cv...ha7t to sol_target_wallets.json)
proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: copy_trade is dormant after 30+ days of zero trades - its 23-wallet list is unverified and has lost -0.830 SOL lifetime over 537 trades. A direct-Alchemy-RPC sweep of 3 candidate wallets surfaced in research-150 found 2 of 3 are stale (10-day-inactive, leaderboard P&L claims fabricated/inflated) and 1 is genuinely live with 100% WR over 8 RTs and +26.1 SOL realized. The fix is not 'find more wallets' - it's 'verify ALL wallets via RPC weekly, drop the dead ones, keep only the living winners.' Implementation = one cron-style script + a recently-active filter (last_activity_h < 72) and a quality filter (round_trips_N >= 5 AND realized_WR > 60% AND median_pnl_sol_per_RT > +0.10). This is also the only viable way to revive copy_trade - the strategy is in DORMANT status and the brain's playbook has no other revival path.
